article.headline: Disney Jumps 4.7% On Earnings Beat And $3 Billion Savings Target
article.deck: The stock cleared the 119.88 buy point of a 62-week cup and trades inside a buy range that runs to 125.87.
body: Disney rose 5.54, or 4.7%, to 122.48 as of 11:17 a.m. Mountain, clearing the 119.88 buy point of a 62-week cup. The cup is 23.0% deep, running from a rim on Aug. 22, 2025, to a low of 92.19 on March 27, 2026. The buy range runs to 125.87, and the stock sits 2.2% past the buy point, inside it. Volume is on pace for 1.36x its 50-day average.

Today is the breakout session. The stock trades 0.3% below its 52-week high of 122.88, and the relative strength line is at a new high. Disney is 11.3% above its 50-day line at 110.07 and 17.8% above its 200-day line at 103.94. It sits 0.28 ATRs from the 21-day line at 115.84, so the move is not stretched. RS rank is 82 of 99 on the desk's list; shares are up 7.7% this year and 15.9% over the past year.

The latest quarter in the desk's table, ended June 30, showed earnings of $1.51 a share, down 48.3% from a year earlier, on revenue of $25.25 billion, up 6.8%. The three quarters before it posted EPS of $1.27, $1.34 and $0.73. The next report is listed for Feb. 1, 2027. Disney carries a market value of $209.1 billion at 14.38 times forward earnings.

The news is behind the move. Zacks reported that Disney's fourth-quarter earnings beat estimates and revenue rose from a year ago. 24/7 Wall St. reported the company wants $3 billion in savings with more layoffs coming, and TIKR reported it is weighing a free Disney+ tier as its Asia parks weaken.
A close back under 119.88 would turn the breakout into a stalled one.
article.watch: Whether Disney closes above the 119.88 buy point and inside the buy range that tops out at 125.87.

article.headline: TransMedics Climbs 4.8% As Organ Transplant Revenue Grows 41.1%
article.deck: A 12-week cup cleared its 95.28 buy point, and the stock trades inside a buy range that runs to 100.04.
body: TransMedics rose 4.48, or 4.8%, to 98.39 as of 11:17 a.m. Mountain, clearing the 95.28 buy point of a 12-week cup. The cup is 32.1% deep, from a rim on Aug. 21 to a low of 64.64 on Oct. 30, and the buy range runs to 100.04. The stock is 3.3% past the buy point, inside the range. Volume is on pace for 0.88x its 50-day average.

The cup formed after a bigger correction: the stock is still well below its 156.00 high from Dec. 2, 2025, which it gave up on the way to a 60.10 low on May 13, and it trades 36.9% under that 52-week high. TransMedics is 22.0% above its 50-day line at 80.68 and 8.1% above its 200-day line at 91.04. It sits 1.85 ATRs from the 21-day line at 84.18, firm but not stretched. RS rank is 88 of 99 on the desk's list, though the RS line is 39.2% below its high. The stock is up 31.6% in a month and down 19.1% this year.

Revenue carries the story. Sales rose 41.1% to $203.0 million in the September quarter, up from $160.8 million in the December 2025 quarter, with a gain in each quarter since. Earnings fell 30.3% to 46 cents a share. The company reported Nov. 5, and no next report date is listed. TransMedics is valued at $3.42 billion, 39.58 times forward earnings.

Zacks noted on Nov. 9 that the stock had broken above its 50-day line and flashed a golden cross, and on Nov. 10 that it reclaimed the 200-day line. An Insider Monkey piece said some experts think the company has a near-monopoly on keeping donor organs alive.
A close back under 95.28 would leave a stalled breakout.
article.watch: Whether TransMedics closes above the 95.28 buy point and below the 100.04 top of the buy range.

article.headline: SailPoint Jumps 7.8% As Identity Security Revenue Grows 16.8%
article.deck: A bounce off the 50-day line leaves the stock 9.8% under the 24.10 buy point of a deep 56-week cup, with an early entry at 21.42 already cleared.
body: SailPoint rose 1.57, or 7.8%, to 21.75 as of 11:17 a.m. Mountain after the session's low touched the 50-day line at 20.22. The stock is in a 56-week deep cup, 57.1% from a rim on Oct. 6, 2025, to a low of 10.30 on April 10, 2026, with a buy point of 24.10 and a buy range to 25.31. It sits 9.8% below the buy point. Volume is on pace for 0.4x its 50-day average.

Two early entries are live. The stock has cleared the 21.42 handle high from Nov. 11, the early entry ahead of the 24.10 buy point. The 50-day bounce gives another: a move above today's high of 21.95, 0.9% overhead, with the 50-day line as the stop.

SailPoint trades 3.8% below its 52-week high of 22.62, 7.6% above its 50-day line and 33.8% above its 200-day line at 16.26. It sits 0.0 ATRs from the 21-day line at 20.43 because the day's low reached it, so the trend is intact and nothing is stretched. RS rank is 92 of 99 on the desk's list; the RS line is 5.8% below its high.

The company sells identity-security software. Revenue rose 16.8% to $308.8 million in the quarter ended July 31, and it lost 9 cents a share, after losses of 13 cents, 6 cents and 6 cents in the three quarters before. The next report is due Dec. 8. SailPoint is valued at $12.4 billion, at 53.96 times forward earnings.
A close back under the 50-day line would undo the bounce.
article.watch: A move through today's 21.95 high with the 50-day line at 20.22 holding, ahead of earnings on Dec. 8.
